_comment: Dealership Accelerator has no posting API, so the adapter drives the real UI. Everything DA-specific lives here so a LeadVenture page change is a config edit, not a code change. NO CREDENTIALS GO IN THIS FILE - the session lives in a browser profile outside the repo.
_how_to_fill: 1. Put the two URLs below in by hand - copy them out of your browser address bar.
2. Run: python ims-ads.py da-login    (sign in yourself; nothing is typed for you)
3. With the composer open, the selectors below can be read off the real page.
Until every FILL-ME is replaced, publishing refuses to run rather than
clicking a control it cannot identify.

session._comment: Holds live session cookies. Kept outside the repo on purpose. Blank uses ~/.ims-ads/da-profile.

selectors._comment: CSS selectors on the DA post composer. signed_out_marker, success_marker and post_link are optional but make failures obvious instead of silent.
